description: KEYWORD/Boolean search over the same 24M+ biomedical abstracts, matching EXACT TERMS rather than meaning. Use this instead of search_corpus when the query contains specific identifiers — gene symbols (TP53, BRCA1), variants (p.Gly12Asp, c.35G>A, rs334), accessions, clinical-trial IDs (NCT…), cell lines, drug codes — or when you want PubMed-style Boolean logic. Vector search loses the exact identity of rare strings, so keyword mode is substantially better for these queries and worse for open natural-language questions. Syntax: terms are ANDed by default; AND / OR / NOT are supported; prefix a term with - to exclude it; use "quoted phrases" for exact adjacent wording. A very broad query is ranked over its best BM25 matches.

author.description: Author name, matched as whole words in the order typed, case-insensitive (optional)

doi.description: Exact DOI (e.g. "10.1021/acs.biochem.6c00105"), in any case, with or without https://doi.org/ (optional)

format.description: Leave out for the readable list. "ris" (imports into Zotero, Mendeley and EndNote) or "bibtex" (Zotero, Mendeley, LaTeX): the same papers as a citation file, returned as the result text. "json": the papers as JSON records (optional)

journal.description: Journal name, matched as whole words in the journal field, case-insensitive ("Nature" also finds Nature Medicine) (optional)

offset.description: Skip this many ranked results to get the next page: 0 (default), then topK, then 2 x topK, with every other argument unchanged. offset + topK at most 200 (optional)

query.description: Keyword or Boolean query, e.g. 'TP53 AND apoptosis NOT mouse' or 'BRCA1 "triple negative breast cancer"'. Include at least one distinctive term.

studyType.description: Only papers that PubMed classes as any of these study types (papers with a PubMed ID). "clinical trial" includes randomized controlled trials and "review" includes systematic reviews (optional)

titleSearch.description: Words of the paper title, matched as whole words in the order typed, case-insensitive (optional)

topK.description: Number of results to return (default 20, max 100)

type.description: Article type filter (optional). Nearly every paper in the corpus has type "article", so this filter rarely narrows a search. To find reviews, trials or other study types, use studyType.

yearFrom.description: Only papers from this year onwards (optional)

yearTo.description: Only papers up to this year (optional)

name: search_corpus_keyword
title: Search papers by exact terms
